countries.reasoning: US is a major consumer and producer of polystyrene foam, data from industry associations and USGS chemicals reports 2022-2023; high confidence but exact 2023 figures slightly extrapolated.
China leads in polystyrene foam production capacity as per Chinese industry data and global chemical production reports up to 2023; very reliable and recent sources.
Germany is a top European producer of polystyrene foam; data from European chemical industry reports 2022; solid but less direct data than US and China.
Japan holds a strong position in specialty foam production; industry reports from Asia Pacific Chemical Review 2023 confirm significant production; moderate to high confidence.
South Korea is a key producer of polystyrene foam for domestic and export markets; data from Korean chemical industry sources 2022; slightly less comprehensive than other countries.
